description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a language selection screen within an authentication flow. It allows users to choose their preferred language from a list and persists the selection before navigating to OTP validation.

classes.name: LanguageScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that presents language options for the user to select, storing the choice and proceeding to OTP validation.

classes.name: _LanguageScreenState
classes.description: State class for LanguageScreen managing UI state, language selection, and navigation logic.

methods.name: _onNext
methods.description: Handles the action when the user presses the 'NEXT' button: saves preferences and navigates to OTPValidationScreen.
